entries.headline: Six US aircraft, Baltic spy planes and North Sea command jet reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six US military aircraft airborne, including spy aircraft over the Baltic and a nuclear command aircraft over the North Sea. The visible post is truncated after the word “Middle”.

entries.headline: US transports, spy aircraft and surveillance drone reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported multiple US military transport aircraft airborne alongside a spy aircraft and surveillance drone, with air activity near the Black Sea at nearly three times normal levels.

entries.headline: Four USAF transports and Baltic spy aircraft reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported four US Air Force transport aircraft airborne over the Atlantic and Europe alongside a spy aircraft over the Baltic.

entries.headline: Three US transports and North Sea spy aircraft reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported three US military transport aircraft airborne over the United States, a spy aircraft over the North Sea, and Black Sea air activity at 2.6 times normal levels.

entries.headline: US transports and surveillance drone reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported multiple US military transport aircraft airborne across the Atlantic and over the United States, with a surveillance drone also aloft. The visible post is truncated after the words “in the”.

entries.headline: Five US transports and earlier command jet sighting reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported five US military transport aircraft airborne simultaneously, including one near the North Sea, and said a nuclear command aircraft had been spotted earlier that day.

entries.headline: US command aircraft and transport near Persian Gulf reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported US Air Force command aircraft and a transport aircraft near the Persian Gulf, amid reports of explosions and an airport attack in Saudi Arabia.

entries.headline: Six notable aircraft and no coded USAF traffic reported
entries.summary: War Watch described the hour as quiet, with six notable military aircraft airborne and no coded US Air Force radio broadcasts heard that day.

entries.headline: US transports, elevated UK traffic and command jet reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported multiple US military transport aircraft airborne over the United States and North Sea, UK airspace at nearly three times normal traffic, and a nuclear command-and-control jet tracked over the continental United States.

entries.headline: Six cargo aircraft and nuclear command jet reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six US military cargo aircraft airborne over the continental United States and North Sea, plus a nuclear command jet, and said Middle East tensions had increased following an airport attack.

entries.headline: Eight US cargo aircraft and coded USAF broadcast reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six US military cargo aircraft airborne over the United States and two more over the North Sea, with one coded US Air Force radio broadcast heard in the preceding hour.

entries.headline: EAM header code VQSKKX reported
entries.summary: War Watch posted an Emergency Action Message header/preamble alert with header code VQSKKX.
